quote: Except as otherwise provided in NRS 484B.287 [NRS-484B-287-1c, NRS-484B-287-1d, NRS-484B-287-1e, LVMC-11-30-060-A, LVMC-11-30-060-B], 484B.290 [LVMC-11-30-140-B] and 484B.350 [LVMC-11-46-030]: Whenever signals exhibiting the words “Walk,” “Don’t Walk,” “Wait” or similar symbols are in place, such signals indicate as follows: While the “Don’t Walk” or “Wait” indication or an upraised hand symbol is illuminated and flashing but is not accompanied by a countdown timer, a pedestrian may not proceed to cross the highway, but a pedestrian who entered the highway lawfully pursuant to subparagraph (1) [NRS-484B-283-1d1] may continue to cross the highway but must proceed to a curb, sidewalk, safety zone if one is provided or other place of safety before the “Don’t Walk” or “Wait” indication or an upraised hand symbol is illuminated and steady.

activation.condition: A pedestrian faces a governing pedestrian signal flashing Don’t Walk or Wait without a countdown timer.

obligation.description: A pedestrian may not proceed to cross during the no-countdown flashing indication. A pedestrian who entered lawfully under subparagraph (1) may continue, but must reach a listed place of safety before the indication becomes steady.
obligation.source_clause: “Don’t Walk” or “Wait” indication or an upraised hand symbol is illuminated and flashing but is not accompanied by a countdown timer, a pedestrian may not proceed to cross the highway, but a pedestrian who entered the highway lawfully pursuant to subparagraph (1) [NRS-484B-283-1d1] may continue to cross the highway but must proceed to a curb, sidewalk, safety zone if one is provided or other place of safety before the “Don’t Walk” or “Wait” indication or an upraised hand symbol is illuminated and steady.

timing.description: Distinguish first highway entry during Walk from new first entry during flashing; for a lawful prior entrant, compare full-body arrival at a listed safety place with onset of steady indication.

judgment_calls_needed: whether the actual display governs the pedestrian direction
whether prior entry was lawful under subparagraph (1)
whether a cited introductory exception applies
whether the destination is a listed place of safety
